description.narrative: This project in partnership with French RC and Iraqi RC provides multipurpose cash assistance to GBV survivors and at-risk population in Sinjar to allow them to cover their basic needs while encouraging income generating activities and providing referrals to other livelihoods initiatives. BRC supports capacity building in GBV concepts to IRCS and partnering case management agencies' staff and volunteers. The project started in December 2020 with the rehabilitation of a borehole and cash assistance to recently displaced populations, including GBV survivors.

As per the signed GAD attached, this one-off payment to FRC will cover the activities related to the continuation of the GBV project in Sinjar from January to May 2022. Funds were allocated from BRC's COVID-19 Appeal

Extension of one month to the current agreement (until Dec 2021) covering additional 75 cash grants. The funding source is underspent G funds from WCA team.

Payment to cover Multi purpose cash grants for the extension of the project (1st August - 31st November) as per budget and proposal submitted by French RC. Funding includes £50k from SGBV earmarked funds and £24k from MENA G funds

Payment towards French RC for the extension of the MPCA and WASH project in Sinjar (Iraq) with DEC additional funding. The extension will be added to the underspent from the previous GAD and will provide additional 122 cash grants to SGBV victims reported to the project during Phase 1. The funds have been processed as an addendum to the previous grant, bringing the total amount to EUR 194,739 (125,100 + 69,639) French will report on this additional funds on August 31st.
